design_description: The Legion kit takes a restrained, premium approach built around a strong deep burgundy and antique-gold identity. The shirt uses a rich burgundy base with a very subtle tone-on-tone geometric pattern running across the body. It adds structure and depth without competing with the crest or personalization, giving the kit a refined rather than graphic-heavy character. Gold is used sparingly as the signature accent: a fine line around the collar, sleeve cuffs, curved side piping, Momuto branding, player number and Legion crest. The curved piping follows the torso from the underarm toward the hem, helping frame the body and giving an otherwise traditional shirt a more athletic silhouette. The front is deliberately minimal, with the Legion crest over the heart and a small central player number, leaving plenty of negative space. A small Legion hem detail completes the branded treatment. On the back, the same tonal pattern continues beneath a large gold name and number, while a small laurel emblem beneath the collar reinforces the Roman/Legion visual language without making the theme too literal. The shorts remain burgundy and introduce strong gold side stripes, with the player number and crest grouped on one leg and understated Momuto branding on the other. Overall, it is a classic, authoritative and premium-looking kit: burgundy provides weight and seriousness, while the controlled gold detailing gives Legion a regal identity that connects naturally with the name and crest.
